blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱410.97-million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱54.63-million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 54-19-52-35-17-24, with a jackpot prize of ₱410.97 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 draw yielded the winning combination 37-36-20-23-48-26, with a jackpot prize of ₱54.63 million. No bettor won the top prize.
